title: What does this event-time window publish?
description: Choose an arrival pattern, trigger policy, and allowed-lateness horizon. Each event belongs to the same fixed window by event time; its watermark age at arrival determines whether it updates or misses the result.

scenarios.label: Mostly on time
scenarios.detail: One delayed event follows an otherwise orderly stream.

scenarios.label: Mobile reconnect
scenarios.detail: Offline clients release several older events after connectivity returns.

scenarios.label: Partition recovery
scenarios.detail: A stalled source partition resumes after the watermark has advanced.

triggerPolicies.label: Watermark result
triggerPolicies.detail: Emit the on-time pane at the watermark, then update when retained late data arrives.

triggerPolicies.label: Early preview + corrections
triggerPolicies.detail: Publish one provisional pane before the watermark, then the on-time result and retained late corrections.
